lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਦ ਮੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: joban dhan prabhataa kai mad mai ahinis rahai divaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: In the pride of youth, wealth and glory, day and night, he remains intoxicated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa dukh bha(n)jan taa siu man na lagaanaa ||
lines.translation: God is merciful to the meek, and forever the Destroyer of pain, but the mortal does not center his mind on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kotan mai kinahoo guramukh hoi pachhaanaa ||2||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, among millions, only a rare few, as Gurmukh, realize God. ||2||2||
Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tih jogee kau jugat na jaanau ||
lines.translation: That Yogi does not know the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh moh maaiaa mamataa phun jih ghat maahi pachhaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Understand that his heart is filled with greed, emotional attachment, Maya and egotism. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: par ni(n)daa usatat nah jaa kai ka(n)chan loh samaano ||
lines.translation: One who does not slander or praise others, who looks upon gold and iron alike,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa jogee taahi bakhaano ||1||
lines.translation: who is free from pleasure and pain - he alone is called a true Yogi. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਅਚਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਠਹਰਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)chal man dah dis kau dhaavat achal jaahi thaharaano ||
lines.translation: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified and restrained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh ko jo nar mukat taahi tum maano ||2||3||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, whoever knows this technique is judged to be liberated. ||2||3||
Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:
Now, what efforts should I make?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih bidh man ko sa(n)saa chookai bhau nidh paar parau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: How can I dispel the anxieties of my mind? How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਛੁ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਡਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam paai kachh bhalo na keeno taa te adhik darau ||
lines.translation: Obtaining this human incarnation, I have done no good deeds; this makes me very afraid!

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਯਹ ਜੀਅ ਸੋਚ ਧਰਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man bach kram har gun nahee gaae yah jee soch dharau ||1||
lines.translation: In thought, word and deed, I have not sung the Lord's Praises; this thought worries my mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat sun kachh giaan na upajio pas jiu udar bharau ||
lines.translation: I listened to the Guru's Teachings, but spiritual wisdom did not well up within me; like a beast, I fill my belly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੫੮॥੪॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak prabh birad pachhaanau tab hau patit tarau ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, O God, please confirm Your Law of Grace; for only then can I, the sinner, be saved. ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Guru is the ocean, filled with pearls.
The Saints gather in the Ambrosial Nectar; they do not go far away from there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras chog chugahi prabh bhaavai ||
lines.translation: They taste the subtle essence of the Lord; they are loved by God.
Within this pool, the swans find their Lord, the Lord of their souls. ||1||
What can the poor crane accomplish by bathing in the mud puddle?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: keechaR doobai mail na jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It sinks into the mire, and its filth is not washed away. ||1||Pause||
After careful deliberation, the thoughtful person takes a step.
Forsaking duality, he becomes a devotee of the Formless Lord.
He obtains the treasure of liberation, and enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord.
His comings and goings end, and the Guru protects him. ||2||
The swan do not leave this pool.
In loving devotional worship, they merge in the Celestial Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saravar mahi ha(n)s ha(n)s mahi saagar ||
lines.translation: The swans are in the pool, and the pool is in the swans.
They speak the Unspoken Speech, and they honor and revere the Guru's Word. ||3||
The Yogi, the Primal Lord, sits within the celestial sphere of deepest Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naar na purakh kahahu kooo kaise ||
lines.translation: He is not male, and He is not female; how can anyone describe Him?
The three worlds continue to center their attention on His Light.
The silent sages and the Yogic masters seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||4||
The Lord is the source of bliss, the support of the helpless.
The Gurmukhs worship and contemplate the Celestial Lord.
God is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.
Subduing ego, one meets the Lord, and places his feet on the Path. ||5||
He makes many efforts, but still, the Messenger of Death tortures him.
Destined only to die, he comes into the world.
